protocols.title: Cardiovascular clinical quality and capability review
criteria: Distinguish service availability, breadth, experience, process quality, outcomes, and academic capability.
Match clinical claims to the exact population, episode, setting, risk adjustment, denominator, and period.
Reject volume-as-quality and marketing-language-as-capability inferences.
escalation_rules: escalate clinical meaning disputes to an independent cardiovascular specialist
protocols.required_human_competence: Qualified cardiovascular clinical quality or outcomes expertise for professional disposition.

protocols.title: Population health, epidemiology, and health-services review
criteria: Separate observed utilization, population burden, potential demand, and forecast claims.
Freeze geography, population, denominator, attribution, and time before comparison.
Assess selection, surveillance, ecological, and transportability limitations.
escalation_rules: escalate denominator or epidemiologic disputes to independent health-services expertise
protocols.required_human_competence: Qualified epidemiology, population-health, or health-services research expertise.

protocols.title: Operations, access, capacity, and workforce review
criteria: Separate installed capacity, staffed capacity, throughput, access friction, and achievable capacity.
Require explicit operating assumptions and bottleneck evidence.
Test feasibility against workforce, facility, scheduling, transfer, and referral constraints.
escalation_rules: escalate feasibility disputes to an independent healthcare operations specialist
protocols.required_human_competence: Qualified health-system operations, access, capacity, or workforce expertise.

protocols.title: Healthcare finance and capital review
criteria: Separate accounting history, liquidity, leverage, operating performance, and forward capital capacity.
Match fiscal period, obligated group, consolidation scope, and one-time items.
Require scenario assumptions before capital-feasibility claims.
escalation_rules: escalate material finance disputes to independent healthcare-finance expertise
protocols.required_human_competence: Qualified healthcare finance, treasury, capital, or credit expertise.

protocols.title: Health economics, payer dynamics, and competition review
criteria: Freeze market, product, service, geography, payer, and counterfactual before interpreting competition.
Separate descriptive concentration, bargaining conditions, substitution, and causal effects.
Preserve alternative explanations and public-data limitations.
escalation_rules: escalate competition interpretation to independent health-economics expertise
protocols.required_human_competence: Qualified health economics, payer-market, or healthcare competition expertise.

protocols.title: Transaction, regulatory, and governance constraints review
criteria: Distinguish transaction form, affiliation, governance, control, licensure, and approval pathways.
Identify jurisdiction, authority, current rule version, and unresolved counsel questions.
Treat public evidence as diligence input rather than a legal conclusion.
escalation_rules: escalate legal or transaction judgment to qualified independent counsel or transaction expertise
protocols.required_human_competence: Qualified healthcare transaction, regulatory, governance, or legal expertise.

protocols.title: Evidence methods, measurement, and biostatistics review
criteria: Validate the observation-claim-warrant chain, dependency clusters, missingness, and inference class.
Test definition, denominator, vintage, comparability, uncertainty, and sensitivity.
Reject source repetition, model agreement, or citation count as independent corroboration.
escalation_rules: escalate residual method disputes to an independent methods or biostatistics reviewer
protocols.required_human_competence: Qualified evidence synthesis, measurement, epidemiologic methods, or biostatistics expertise.
